title: Bigger Phantoms
description: Adds variation to the size of phantoms that spawn in your world.
body:
# What is this plugin?
This plugin adds variation to the size of phantoms that spawn in your world based on the min and max size you set within the config file.

# Features
- Random phantom sizes.

The current version of the plugin was intentionally kept simple to reduce the likelihood of it breaking between different Minecraft versions.

# Setup:
- Download the jar file.
- Place the file into your server's plugin folder.
- Start the server.
- Edit the config.
- Hide from the big birds!
